item.title: Changzhou Microintelligence Co., Ltd. (03275)
item.description: Robotics firm Microintelligence relaunched its offering on 23 November at HK$12.07-15.69, with subscriptions open 23 November to 1 December and listing on 4 December; it withdrew its October attempt and now seeks up to about HK$585 million. Oversubscribed about 75.9 times.
